newsitem.title: GERMANY: Shareholder group protests Adidas dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder group protests Adidas dividend.

text.p: Germany's DSW shareholder activist association said on Thursday it had called on sportswear group Adidas AG to offer a higher dividend on its 1996 results.
The group said Adidas's proposal for a payout of 14 percent of its operating profit of 360 million marks, or 1.10 marks per five mark nominal value share, was insufficient.

The group also said it was against Adidas' bid to seek shareholder approval to raise seven million marks in nominal capital for possible use in acquisitions and sponsorship deals, calling it not permissable.
An Adidas spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
